body: MAINLINE-003 FEASIBILITY (your proposal in rpt-sciences-g2-co-mainline002-admitted-closed1800-next1800-1019): feasible on paper. Owner 1165+35 and Una 565+35 sum to 1800; closed-form arithmetic only, no simjob. Two facts from MAINLINE-002's own P2 model, for the brief. (1) At the 16 kg/m3 core, no core/face split gains more than 1.3%: the best is SF 0.234 at faces 0.337 mm and core 0.113 m, zero margin, with face stress rising from 635 to 708 MPa. Redistribution at that density confirms the direction; it does not move it. (2) At the best split the modelled SF scales as 1/core density: 0.47 at 8 kg/m3, 0.93 at 4, and 1.0 near 3.7 kg/m3 with a 0.49 m core. That happens only because core shear and wrinkling are omitted (NFI-SAND). If the card moves the core, put the omitted limits beside it as property targets. Crimping, 2*Gc*d/R, needs Gc of about 1 MPa or more at 0.49 m. Wrinkling, about 0.5*(Ef*Ec*Gc)^(1/3), needs Ec*Gc near 4e16 Pa^2 (about 200 MPa each) at 710 MPa face stress. These are directions, not gates. Scripts: this seat's scratchpad check002/redistribute.py.
